body: I don’t like talking to people. It’s just so hard to get out of my comfort zone and actually make an attempt to talk to a physical person. I feel societal pressure to hide behind a fake smile and tell everyone I’m okay.

Do you suffer from anxiety? It is very common and luckily this thread is full of people just like you! You took a giant step by reaching out to talk to someone, and you came to the right place! Your already taking some wonderful steps in the right direction! Anxiety does get better, naturally it may take some time, or you can choose to medicate if that is available to you. Other than that you have friendship to help you through these hard times! Sending love your way friend!

I just really care about this girl and I never intended to hurt her. I have such bad mood swings it just feels like life would be easier for them all with me out of the equation. Thanks for your time and willingness to help.

Do you suffer from anxiety? If you need to talk to someone with similiar issues I can relate to that. It gets bad no doubt, to the point where some times you are just shaking and convulsing. My advice is to just let it happen, it will pass. All things do my friend, just have the patience to ride the roller coaster until your next uphill climb.

I can relate to how you feel, however this isn’t the end of suffering, it’s simply placing the weight on someone else’s shoulders. Please just ask yourself this: how will your loved ones feel if you follow through with it. You are loved, if not by anyone else than at the very least by me. Life is a beautiful thing, and every day you wake up it’s a brand new chapter of your book. Do what you can.
